summary: The agency declined to incorporate manufacturers' comments questioning weight reduction, noting that the 50-pound weight reduction scenario applies only to GM and that GM did not claim weight reduction was impossible.
text: The manufacturers' comments on the impossibility of weight reduction are not incorporated because the application of weight reduction is only to GM and they did not say it was impossible.
